hints.title: Distinct Product Aggregation
hints.text: A product may appear multiple times on the same date. Deduplicate products per sell_date.

hints.title: String Concatenation Aggregate
hints.text: group_concat(distinct product order by product separator ",") in MySQL concatenates names alphabetically.

hints.title: Distinct Count Calculation
hints.text: count(distinct product) as num_sold provides the unique product tally per date.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT sell_date,
       COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS num_sold,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT product ORDER BY product SEPARATOR ',') AS products
FROM Activities
GROUP BY sell_date
ORDER BY sell_date;
```

complexity.notes: Group-by aggregation sorts distinct product names per date in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Without DISTINCT in GROUP_CONCAT, duplicate sales produce redundant repetitive lists.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-engine string concatenation assembles CSV output directly without application-level overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: GROUP_CONCAT with DISTINCT and ORDER BY sorting inside the aggregate function.

solutions.code:
SELECT sell_date,
       COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS num_sold,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT product ORDER BY product SEPARATOR ',') AS products
FROM Activities
GROUP BY sell_date
ORDER BY sell_date;

SELECT sell_date,
       COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS num_sold,
       STRING_AGG(DISTINCT product, ',' ORDER BY product) AS products
FROM Activities
GROUP BY sell_date
ORDER BY sell_date;

solutions.approach: Pandas Groupby Agg with Sorted Set Join
